siteDescription: DeutschConnect – a student initiative for collaboration between schools in Ankara.

hero.description: Good ideas go beyond school boundaries. Discover shared activities, get involved and help us shape collaboration between schools in Ankara.
hero.mapNote: One planned pilot. Two schools. Shared possibilities.

pilot.title: The start of a connection
pilot.description: Starting at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara, we hope to launch our first joint pilot with Anka Bilim.
pilot.label: First planned pilot

homeEvents.title: What could bring us together
homeEvents.description: A conversation, an experiment, a new perspective. Here is what shared activities could look like.

demoNotice: These activities are fictional examples. There are no confirmed dates or registrations yet.

sprachwerkstatt.title: Connected through German
sprachwerkstatt.description: Start a conversation, learn from each other and explore German together.
sprachwerkstatt.detail: A shared language workshop could bring students from both schools together in small groups. Icebreakers, conversations and creative tasks could create space to use German without the pressure of grades.

ideenlabor.title: Thinking further, together
ideenlabor.description: Ask questions, share ideas and develop small experiments as a team.
ideenlabor.detail: A cross-school ideas lab could connect students with an interest in science. Together they could develop a research question and explore how to investigate it through simple experiments.

kulturbruecken.title: Two schools. Many perspectives.
kulturbruecken.description: Get to know each other's languages, stories and everyday school life.
kulturbruecken.detail: A cultural afternoon could offer a chance to talk about music, languages and everyday life at both schools. The programme would be developed together with participating students and school coordinators.

codewerkstatt.title: Coding, together.
codewerkstatt.description: Build a small website and write your first lines of code together.
codewerkstatt.detail: In this fictional coding workshop, students from both schools build a small website together. The demo format illustrates what practical collaboration around technology could look like.

aboutPage.title: By students. For new connections.
aboutPage.description: We want to think about digital school organisation beyond the boundaries of a single school.
aboutPage.storyText: An initial idea for a German learning platform evolved into a new focus at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara: students from different schools should be able to shape educational opportunities and shared experiences together. An earlier FlutterFlow prototype by Ege provides the visual foundation for this new direction.
aboutPage.missionText: Students should be able to contribute ideas, find collaborators and help shape shared activities, even without an official role. Exchange through the German language is our first practical focus.
aboutPage.statusText: DeutschConnect is in the concept and prototype phase. This website is an initial technical step. A practical pilot with Anka Bilim is intended; there are no documented event outcomes yet.
